tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background and the default section in the section rhythm (`bg`, `surface`, `bg`). Pairs with `text` (17.3:1 / 16.1:1) and `muted` (6.3:1 / 7.2:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, terminal blocks and the alternate section. Pairs with `text` (18.9:1 / 15.4:1) and `muted` (6.9:1 / 6.9:1). Never stack two sections of the same background.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Card hover background, table headers, code blocks, guidance notes. Pairs with `text` (16.0:1 / 14.1:1) and `muted` (5.8:1 / 6.3:1). `accent` text fails here in executive (3.2:1).

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Terminal title bar. Pairs with `muted` (5.8:1 / 6.3:1). index.html overrides engineering to #161618 for its own page; this token keeps the css/brand.css value.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card and panel edges; the only depth signal on cards. Decorative contrast only: 1.3:1 on `bg` in executive and 1.4:1 in engineering, under the 3:1 a control border needs, so a control must also be told apart by its label.

tokens.name: border-sub
tokens.usage: Quieter divider inside a card or between list entries. Decorative only, never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on `bg`, `surface`, `raised` and `faint`, at least 14:1 in both themes. brand-guidelines.html section 7 lists engineering as #F4F4F5, the guideline's default dark reading pair; css/brand.css (#E8E8ED) is what the pages render.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, labels, kickers, prompt glyphs on `bg`, `surface`, `raised` and `faint`, at least 5.8:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: orange-500. Primary brand signal: CTAs, chevron and prompt symbols, key words, interaction states; one per visual region. Orange answers 'is this important?'; AI blue answers 'is AI involved here?'. Never swap them. Text on `accent` is `on-accent`, never white (3.8:1). FAILING SOURCE PAIRS, kept: as small text it is 3.5:1 on `bg`, 3.8:1 on `surface` and 3.2:1 on `raised` in executive, so reserve it there for text 24px or larger and non-text marks (3:1 floor). In engineering it passes: 5.2:1 on `bg`, 5.0:1 on `surface`, 4.6:1 on `raised`.

tokens.name: accent-deep
tokens.usage: orange-700. Hover, active, pressed states of `accent`. As text it passes on `bg` (4.5:1) and `surface` (4.9:1) in executive, and fails on `raised` (4.2:1) and on engineering grounds (4.0:1 on `bg`). FAILING SOURCE PAIR, kept: `.btn-primary:hover` puts #000 on this fill at 4.3:1.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: orange-300. Soft highlights and subtle backgrounds. Not a text colour in executive (1.9:1 on `bg`); dark text on it reads 10:1.

tokens.name: accent-glow
tokens.usage: Optional glow, cursor and motion accents only. Never body text; never on the logo.

tokens.name: accent-dim
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind a selected item (`.concept-selected`). index.html uses 0.08 for its own page.

tokens.name: accent-dim2
tokens.usage: Card hover border and the edge of a tinted fill, over `accent-dim`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an `accent` fill: primary button in brand-guidelines.html, active mode button. 5.2:1. `.btn-primary` in index.html uses #000 (5.6:1). Name added here: the source writes the literal.

tokens.name: ai-accent
tokens.usage: AI blue. A semantic signal, not a brand accent: AI-generated output, AI-agent steps in diagrams, links to AI tooling, 'AI-generated' tags. Orange answers 'is this important?'; AI blue answers 'is AI involved here?'. Never swap them. Never for brand headings, CTAs, section labels, primary navigation, status badges or human-activity arcs. Never as text on light surfaces: 1.8:1 on #F6F5F3, 2.0:1 on #FFFFFF, a failing pair the brand forbids. Text use is engineering only, 9.8:1 on #0B0B0B. On light surfaces carry it as a fill or border with `text` beside it.

tokens.name: ai-blue-500
tokens.usage: The brand-guidelines.html name for `ai-accent`. The blue scale calls the same value `blue-400`, and its own `blue-500` is a different colour, so use `ai-accent`.

tokens.name: nav-bg
tokens.usage: Sticky nav background under `backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(180%)`. Lifted from `.site-nav`.

tokens.name: nav-active-bg
tokens.usage: Active nav item fill, index.html. The engineering value uses AI blue on navigation, which conflicts with the signal rule; see the README.

tokens.name: nav-active-text
tokens.usage: Text on `nav-active-bg`, 5.2:1 / 10.8:1.

tokens.name: nav-active-ring
tokens.usage: Ring around the active nav item, index.html.

tokens.name: code
tokens.usage: Code text in the brand brief, on `surface` and `raised`: 11.7:1 and 9.9:1 in executive, 12.2:1 and 11.1:1 in engineering.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations. Fill or icon beside a word. FAILING as text in executive: 2.1:1 on `bg`. Passes in engineering, 8.6:1. Success and `error` differ by only 1.7:1, so always add a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Cautions. FAILING as text in executive: 2.0:1 on `bg`. Passes in engineering, 9.2:1. Never adjacent to orange in the same control (forbidden pairing).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions; danger button border and text on dark grounds only, 5.2:1 on #0B0B0B. FAILING as text in executive: 3.5:1 on `bg`. Dark text on it: 5.2:1.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational status. In brand-guidelines.html, absent from css/brand.css. FAILING as text in executive: 3.4:1 on `bg`. White body copy on it is forbidden (3.7:1). Passes in engineering, 5.4:1.
